Visible titles include: “RICH DAD POOR DAD” (top), “THIS IS MARKETING” (Seth Godin), “SELL LIKE CRAZY” (Sabr Suby), “CRUSHING IT!” (Gary Vaynerchuk), “GUERRILLA MARKETING” (Jay Conrad Levinson), “SELL OR BE SOLD” (Grant Cardone), and “HOW TO GET …” style marketing books (some text partially obscured).

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows multiple marketing/sales book spines.

claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints

risks.risk: Some books may be reprints/unauthorized editions (or photocopies) rather than original copies.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the copyright/ISBN page for 2–3 representative books (including one with the most valuable title) showing publisher and ISBN.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used books with possible reprint/unknown edition risk (worst case: treat as not guaranteed original).

risks.risk: There may be writing, highlighting, stamps, or missing pages inside.
risks.proof: Photo of 1–2 interior pages per book (open to a random page) showing no pen/highlight and intact pages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if writing/marks may exist (worst case: treat as not meeting 'no writing inside').

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible from spines (torn covers, water damage, bent pages).
risks.proof: Photos of front cover, back cover, and the bottom edge of the pages for 2–3 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average wear (worst case: no premium for 'like new').

risks.risk: Not all titles/quantity are shown; the stack may be incomplete or different from what’s being sold.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full set laid out with all covers/spines visible, plus a count of total books.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the visible set only, without assuming additional books beyond photo 0.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the copyright/ISBN page for each book (or at least 3 most valuable titles) to confirm original editions.
Send interior photos (random open pages) for each book showing there is no writing/highlighting.
Send photos of front cover + back cover + page edges for each book to confirm condition.
Confirm the total number of books included (photo 0 may not show the full set).
response.reason: The photos confirm the general type (marketing/sales books) and several titles, but originality and 'no writing inside' cannot be verified from spines alone. To price confidently in Lagos, you need ISBN/copyright-page proof and interior page photos.
